sharedRules.scope: Shared authored rules remain local to these four exact identities; no global rule or accepted interface is changed.

phantom-armageddon.commitment: Action,V/S/F; ordinary range and identity checks precede commitment. Choose school variant and any Reality Break mode before paying. Cast spends once. Area membership is snapshotted at manifestation. Ready pays and resolves cast side effects at setup, holds concentration, expires next actual regular own START, and releases once with a legal Reaction after trigger; targeting occurs then. Effect clocks begin at manifestation; no second cast/cost/strain at release. Source component failure, countering, interruption, replacement or expiry refunds nothing already committed.
phantom-armageddon.control: Before new Stunned or Unconscious admission, resolve survival, actual condition defenses and source-character/target encounter hard-denial allowance. Spend the combined mark once only upon successful new whole-Action denial. Used allowance blocks that new rider only; independent damage remains. No downgraded substitute control or repeated attempt after immunity/suppression. Existing admitted control may resume for its remaining original duration if a suppressor ends; no new costs, mark, duration or fresh side-effect such as another item drop. Full Stunned and Unconscious semantics apply, including ending concentration, no Actions/BonusAction/Reaction, movement prohibition, specified automatic saves and attack consequences. Frightened/flight/slow are not whole-Action denial.
phantom-armageddon.eligibility: Before commitment bind actor identity, class level, acquired repertoire/prepared matrix, actual class-school row, component availability and focus custody, current life/body, Action eligibility, rank gate and RP. Rank9 minimum class17 and native base26 RP in every route. School placement alone gives no acquired route. Revalidate target/range/line of effect at manifestation. A paid legal cast whose targets later fail remains spent; an illegal precommit attempt spends nothing.
phantom-armageddon.geometryAndInformation: NEW for these enemy-selective spells: designated enemies are creatures the caster currently perceives and regards as hostile; no objective allegiance oracle. Snapshot ALL qualifying designated enemies in the declared geometry without optional post-roll omissions. A mistaken hostile is affected. A concealed unknown enemy is not discovered. Allies/self are excluded unless perceived hostile designation actually applies; Weird instead snapshots every creature including self, allies and unperceived bodies in its area with source line of effect. Use actual occupied body geometry/full 3D, range and total-cover segments. Unknown scene/body/cover facts hold the affected admission, not invented coordinates.
phantom-armageddon.packet: One independent damage roll per target per damage event, declared before outcomes, not one shared roll across targets. Binary saves use actual DC/modifiers and advantage/disadvantage, no generic natural1/20 save exception. Save half rounds down before defenses; resistance once, immunity separately, then tempHP, normalHP, instant death, Wound save/injury, zero-HP lifecycle, concentration and living riders in accepted order. No event silently selects Wound/injury/death dice. Hold at the next unavailable input. Surviving damage is never rolled back by rider resistance, awakening, illusion recognition, dispel, suppression, expiry or source death.
phantom-armageddon.phaseBridge: For target-bound recurring records use actual regular target START damage and END saves. A source-supported companion without an independent regular turn uses its single attached controller-phase START/END once per controller regular turn; controller changes cannot add an exposure or move an existing expiry. Extra/attached actions confer no extra periodic marker. Outside initiative use initial packet then six-second START/END opportunity pairs (packet then save); transition maps each first unresolved opportunity to the next lawful marker without duplicating exposure. Actual grant, controller and phase must be bound; missing genuine extra-turn/companion evidence is held.
phantom-armageddon.qualifications: No runtime execution, human play, balance judgment, cosmology decision, domain closure or release approval. No world-ending, new planes, summoned beings, memory extraction, hidden knowledge, creature anatomy, campaign immunity, acquisition or revival authorization follows from these names or authored fixtures.
phantom-armageddon.recurringFamily: NEW explicit local extension of the P20 family/exposure interface for Mass Phantom Killer and Weird only: one packet per named family/recipient/actual numbered round, across owners and including an initial packet. Earliest active eligible application wins; ties use application order then immutable source ID. Mark the family opportunity before defense/HP resolution; losing due applications lose that opportunity. Suppressed sources lose their own due packet, cannot bank it, but do not consume another active source's opportunity. Independent ending WIS saves survive suppression. Family histories survive recasts/ownership copies. Mass Phantom Killer, Weird and Greater Phantasmal Killer are three distinct families.
phantom-armageddon.resources: Use actual RP, Dissonance, Refrain, surcharges, class discounts and active passives. Base strain rank9=2; Wizard first distinct prepared underlying family=0 base only. Subsequent immediate same-name casts add capped Refrain1/2/3. No generic Overcast. First-cast exceptions never reset by copies, changing school, Ready release, suppression or new recipients. Keep resource history. No assumed reductions or kill-resource farm.
phantom-armageddon.roots: Every cast has an immutable source owner, class/school, rank, component roots and target admissions. Child damage retains original root, funding, type and Null provenance; a Null-qualified hit preserves its actual recipient lifecycle restriction and cannot acquire a final-death/head-destruction side path. Damage, private perception, body consequence, fear, stun, sleep, voluntary flight and forced displacement are separate records. A source covering only one component affects only that component. No unsourced generic mental immunity or all-effects dispel.
phantom-armageddon.scope: NEW PF181 spell-local authored selections for exactly the seven IDs. Native text/access is copied intact in each procedure. Proposed overrides of Instantaneous recurrence metadata and missing saves/durations are labeled; no global authority is asserted.
phantom-armageddon.termination: Concentration ends on actual failure, incapacitation, death, voluntary ending or replacement unless an acquired specific exception applies. For non-concentration target conditions source death does not itself reset/erase their finite virtual endpoints. Target final death removes living conditions, not physical remains or ledger. Suppression blocks covered active components while clocks, mandatory saves and independently scheduled actors continue; no missed pulse, flight, forced displacement or head consequence replays on resumption. At an absolute maximum deadline expire before a coincident packet.
phantom-armageddon.timing: Each actor owns its actual regular START/END calendar; spell damage opportunities are separately registered. At START expire due start effects and Ready, refresh Reaction and regular budgets, tick recharge, process legal absolute recovery and required death save before spell start effects and voluntary decisions.
